# dgx-spark-llm-serving

> Field notes and an operational guard for local vLLM serving on NVIDIA DGX Spark, covering model selection, serving flags, generation wedges, multi-node links, and unattended recovery.

## Project documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Records measured serving behavior, deployment flags, failure modes, fleet networking, and reliability practices.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): Contains the MIT license terms.
- [evidence/throughput-2026-09-04.md](evidence/throughput-2026-09-04.md): Records four single-stream Qwen3 FP8 vLLM throughput runs and their limits.
- [evidence/multinode-2026-07-and-08.md](evidence/multinode-2026-07-and-08.md): Records iperf3 and NCCL results with test conditions.
- [docs/case-study-wedge-2026-08-26.md](docs/case-study-wedge-2026-08-26.md): Records one generation wedge, guard recovery, and workload effect.

## Operations

- [scripts/engine-guard.sh](scripts/engine-guard.sh): Probes real text generation and restarts a wedged vLLM container after repeated failures.
- [systemd/engine-guard.service](systemd/engine-guard.service): Runs the engine guard from a systemd user service.
- [systemd/engine-guard.timer](systemd/engine-guard.timer): Runs the engine guard after boot and every 10 minutes after each run.
